attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 16, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue of INR 5,253 million, a 22.1% year-over-year increase. EBITDA was INR 976 million, up 15.2%, while profit after tax reached INR 586 million, a 31.3% growth. Return on capital employed stood at 38.6% and return on equity at 36.1%. For H1 FY27, revenue totaled INR 10,158 million, a 20.4% increase. EBITDA was INR 1,927 million, up 27.7%, and profit after tax was INR 1,142 million, a 56.3% rise. ROCE was 40.1% and ROE was 36.9%. The company highlighted organic growth of 12.7% in the first half and noted its AI-first customer experience services across 14 countries.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited intimates that Mr. Ritesh Chakraborty, Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director with DIN 11015389, will not seek re-appointment upon retirement by rotation at the 23rd Annual General Meeting. He cited pre-occupations and professional commitments as reasons. His tenure as a director will cease with effect from the conclusion of the ensuing 23rd Annual General Meeting. The company filed this notice under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations on November 20, 2026.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited has made the audio recording of its earnings conference call for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, available on its website. The call was held on November 16, 2026, at 4.00 PM IST to discuss unaudited financial results on a standalone and consolidated basis. This filing is submitted under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company previously intimated the details of the call on November 10, 2026. The announcement was signed by Barun Singh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited submitted newspaper advertisements on November 15, 2026, regarding the extract of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Financial Express editions across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Pune, and Delhi, as well as in Duranta Barta in Kolkata. The company also uploaded the information to its website at www.fusioncx.com. This filing complies with Regulation 30 and Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The submission was signed by Barun Singh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited filed a presentation for its Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call under Regulation 30 of SEBI regulations. The call is scheduled for November 16, 2026. The presentation details financial performance for the period. Revenue for H1 FY27 was INR 10,158 Mn. EBITDA was INR 1,927 Mn. Profit after tax was INR 1,142 Mn. The company reported organic growth of 12.7 percent and inorganic growth of 7.7 percent during H1 FY27. Fusion CX operates 42 delivery locations across 14 countries. It serves over 750 clients. The company maintains an AI-first approach with embedded platforms. The presentation includes details on the board composition and management team. It also outlines the company's global delivery scale and industry expertise. The document contains forward-looking statements and standard disclaimers.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "Press Release- Financial Results for Q2 & H1 FY 2026-27".
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was INR 5,253 Mn, up 22.1% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR 976 Mn with a margin of 18.6%. Profit after tax was INR 586 Mn, up 31.3% year-on-year. Diluted earnings per share were INR 4.60. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was INR 10,158 Mn, up 20.4% year-on-year. EBITDA was INR 1,927 Mn, up 27.7% year-on-year. Profit after tax was INR 1,142 Mn, up 56.3% year-on-year. Diluted earnings per share were INR 8.96. The company announced a conference call on Monday, November 16th, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026 for Appointment of M/S Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP, as Statutory Auditor
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.75 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26, subject to member approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. The record date for this dividend is fixed as November 27, 2026. The board also recommended the ratification of the Employee Stock Option Scheme 2023, the appointment of M/S Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP as Statutory Auditor, and CS Pravin Kumar Drolia as Secretarial Auditor, all pending shareholder approval. Additionally, Mr. Rakesh Sony, Mr. Narayanan Subramaniam, and Mr. Andrew Jay Wilmott were appointed as Additional Directors, subject to member approval.
